title: Acceptance implies language membership
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $s\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every binary input $y$ there is a time bound under which $N$ halts on every branch, uses at most $s(|y|)$ work-tape cells on every branch, and accepts $y$ exactly when $y\in L$. If a binary string $x$ is accepted by $N$ within $t$ steps for some $t\in\mathbb{N}$, then $x\in L$.
